label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The issue states that uploads are failing with "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" on row 1 since switching to a new accounting export tool on Windows. This indicates that Windows line endings (CRLF / \r\n) or line splitting behavior in src/ingest/parser.ts is causing row column counts to mismatch or headers/rows to parse incorrectly.
